text:
nora: quick flag - deploybot started a staged roll of `engine-quant-7.0+abi13` in us-east-1 during the midday window. Canary is reporting increased tail latency and a small cluster-level thermal jitter. thinking pin until we root cause.

deploybot: ACTION: rollout in-flight for bundle engine-quant-7.0+abi13 in us-east-1. Canary slice: 25 hosts. (check `deploybot status 1751234567`)

sre-bot: telemetry snapshot: 99th latency +18%, error-rate steady at 0.3% but a dozen gpu thermal warnings across 4 racks. heatmap: short spikes coincident with heavy matmul ops. link: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1751234567

chen: logs from canary host ue1-canary-12:
```
[2026-03-21T12:02:11Z] runtime: matmul_q7 dispatch=tiling_v2
[2026-03-21T12:02:12Z] thermal: GPU temp jump 78C -> 92C within 2s
[2026-03-21T12:02:13Z] driver: WARN nvml: throttle event
[2026-03-21T12:02:14Z] runtime: tail_latency=312ms seq=1024 model=engine-quant-7.0
```

ops-anya: thermal throttle is concerning. Could be new tiling causing sustained SM utilization. Do we have repro?

nora: not yet. Frank, can you run a focused stress job with tiling_v2 enabled on a staging host with identical firmware?

frank: will run `tests/stress_matmul --tiling tiling_v2 --seq 1024 --duration 10m` now. Also recommend temporary pin to prevent expansion.

chen: idea: shorten pin TTL to 90m and pause region expansion. That buys time for repro and lets us avoid a full rollback if we find a thermal tuning parameter.

sre-bot: suggested alert created: RED-3400 "engine-quant-7.0 thermal jitter in us-east-1 canary". Include NVML traces.

nora: proposal and vote: A) pin roll to engine-quant-7.0 with TTL=90m + pause expansion; run repro and attempt micro-tune (raise fan curve / lower power cap) ; if repro shows sustained thermal throttling or >2% 5xx -> rollback to engine-quant-6.4. B) immediate region rollback.

chen: +1 for A, we should try micro-tune before rollback.

frank: repro started; early nvml shows SM util ~98% and sustained power draw 320W on one host. I'll post logs in 12m.

ops-anya: micro-tune plan: if repro reproduces, operations can temporarily set power cap to 280W on affected racks and re-run canary. Need approval to change power caps.

nora: approve temporary power cap changes in canary racks only. ops-anya execute if repro matches. Also update release notes: "HOLD: engine-quant-7.0 under investigation for thermal regressions on high-throughput matmul; deploy paused in us-east-1."

deploybot: UPDATE: rollout paused in us-east-1; pin TTL set to 90m by nora.

sre-bot: attached initial nvml dump and chart. Ticket RED-3400 updated.

frank: repro log snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T12:10:02Z] nvml: sm_util=97.8% power=322W
[2026-03-21T12:10:15Z] thermal: temp=91C throttle=active
[2026-03-21T12:10:18Z] runtime: latency p99=340ms seq=1024 tiling=tiling_v2
```

chen: matches canary. ops-anya, please set power cap to 280W on the two affected racks and restart canary slice.

ops-anya: on it. applying caps to rack-7/8 now. ETA 3m.

ops-anya: applied. restarting canary slice.

frank: new run shows p99 back to ~170ms, temp peaks ~82C, no throttle events in 5m window.

nora: good signal. conclusion: tiling_v2 increases sustained power draw on high-seq workloads; mitigation by power cap or fan curve adjustment looks effective. Action items:
- Short-term: keep pin TTL 90m and hold expansion in us-east-1. Ops to schedule controlled canary rerun with adjusted power/fans.
- Medium: engineering follow-up to add an adaptive tiling switch based on host power headroom and extend preflight tests to include sustained-matmul stress.
- Release notes: add "KNOWN ISSUE: engine-quant-7.0 may increase sustained GPU power on certain hardware; rollout paused in us-east-1 pending mitigation."

chen: i'll open a follow-up PR for preflight test and add a telemetry check for sustained power draw.

sre-bot: ticket RED-3400 updated with mitigation and next steps. closing for now but will re-open if new spikes.

nora: thanks team. we'll re-evaluate after the 90m hold. :thumbsup:
